Annang: Kwa ndubi Ewa nkan nkuk nnyin eboñ mkpo.
Ebira: Oruva oruva irezi enẹhi inokokoro dị a nowu.
Efik: Kprukpru mbubreyo, mme ebua ke nkannkuk nnyin enam uyom.
Hausa: Kowane yamma, karnuka a unguwarmu suna yin ihu.

Idoma: Onee doodu a'ewo ega nalo'lanya eyi-fonu.

Tiv: Hanma aikie yô aniywaav mba hen diô-ya wase mba lu vaan.
Yoruba: Gbogbo ìrọ̀lẹ, àwọn aja ni àdúùgbò wa n pa aríwo.
English: It's time to save the internet — again.
Annang: Agwō ini ndi nim internet — amana.
Efik: Ekem ini man anyan̄a internet ndifiak - nnam.
Hausa: Lokaci ya yi don ceton intanet — akai.
Ibibio: Amana-kemini adi yaña internet.
Idoma: Eko gaa ee k'oheta ku internet — kpo.
Igala: Iko ke gbi intaneti dàbi le yá mè.
Igbo: Oge eruola ịzọpụta Ịntanetị — ọzọ.
Tiv: Ka shie u shi yiman intanet.
Yoruba: Ó ti tó àkókò láti tọjú Íńtánẹ́ẹ̀tì — lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.
English: The End!
Annang: Kwa nduwi, mme ewa ke mbók ilóng ajid eche ebóngó mkpo.
English: A donor has since been found.
Annang: Akpene eke ekud agwo unó unwam.
Arabic: كل مساء، الكلاب في حيّنا تُعوي.
Arabic: قد تم العثور على متبرع منذ ذلك الحين.

Efik: Ema ekut ono owo nkpọ.
Eggon: Omba yŋa mbo la onmuore, ebu lo a òkó dzu ma gyi mo la srmo.
Eggon: Are la si o kpo kko di mo hwyne yŋa ba mumi.
French: Chaque soir, les chiens dans notre quartier hurlent.
French: Un donneur a depuis été trouvé.
Hausa: Wani mai bayar da jini an sami shi tun danzu.
Ibibio: Ema ekekid awo se ibinọ
Idoma: Oce je ehi, eloo'ma gboji ee.
Igala: Ádèbie lẹ, Máláfuyè kpó kpẹ mẹ.
Igbo: Achọtala onye na-enye aka kemgbe.
English: Woodbury Heights is governed under the Borough form of New Jersey municipal government.
Nupe: Woodbury Heights wun a de kangi dan gwata miye Borough o nya New Jersey eka kintetengi o.
English: It is proposed to have an entire floor for free and subsidised in-patient beds.
Nupe: Emingan ebo wo de kin kpata efya toh kike dan ekpata gunci o.

Spanish: Se propone tener un piso entero gratuito y subvencionado con camas de hospital.

English: A map is classified as small scale or large scale or sometimes medium scale.

Yoruba: A ti ri Olùfúnni kan báyìí.
Portuguese: Woodbury Heights é governada sob a forma de Borough do governo municipal de Nova Jersey.
Portuguese: Um mapa é classificado como em pequena escala, em grande escala ou às vezes em escala média.
Fongbe: Gbadanu tɛgbɛ ɔ avoun lɛ nɔn do hihó wè.
Fongbe: New York hwe enɛn nú ɔ húzú afɔ sɔ dó té daxo sin sá tɔ daxo lɛ tɔn.

google.notes: Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS on Google Cloud Vertex AI. Vertex returns raw 24 kHz PCM, which Hypa wraps as WAV. Hypa preserves its existing language selector; only documented Gemini-TTS language codes are accepted.

mansa.notes: Native MT. Requires an explicit source language (no auto-detect). No creativity or max_tokens params. Beta languages (Kirundi, Ndebele (South), Swati, Tigrinya, Twi, Ewe, Lingala, Kikongo, Bambara, Bemba) mainly pair only with English.

mansa.name: mansa-transcribe
mansa.notes: Native ASR. Requires an exact language/dialect name — generic "Arabic" is not valid here, pick an Arabic (...) dialect row instead. durationSeconds is required, must be a whole number, and is what Mansa bills on.

mansa.name: mansa-tts
mansa.notes: Native TTS, WAV output. Mansa supports streaming; Hypa requests buffered audio. Every language accepts male/female. English also accepts 10 regional accents and 74 {language}_{gender}_speaker voices (English spoken with that language's accent); 10 speaker ids are duplicates of the regional accents (igbo_male_speaker=nigerian_male, yoruba_female_speaker=nigerian_female, twi_*=ghanaian_*, swahili_*=east_african_*, xhosa_*=south_african_*, arabic_*=north_african_*).

yarnGPT.name: yarn_gpt
yarnGPT.notes: Character-priced TTS with asynchronous jobs. Supports English, Pidgin, Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo. USD price uses standard credits and the October 16, 2026 exchange-rate snapshot.

elevenlabs.name: eleven_v3
elevenlabs.notes: ElevenLabs' most expressive multilingual text-to-speech model. Hosted by ElevenLabs.

elevenlabs.name: eleven_multilingual_v2
elevenlabs.notes: ElevenLabs' lifelike, consistent multilingual model for stable long-form speech. Hypa limits requests to 5,000 characters.

elevenlabs.name: eleven_flash_v2_5
elevenlabs.notes: ElevenLabs' fast, affordable multilingual model for interactive speech. Hypa limits requests to 5,000 characters.
